read.thesis: Record FY25 revenue $28.5B (+20%) and $44B backlog; company self-funding a $500-700M transformer vertical supply chain, with 2026 FCF guided to $1.8B and no 765kV work in 2026 backlog.

capex.quote: strategically investing approximately $500,000,000 to $700,000,000 over the next several years in our power transformer manufacturing facilities

triggers.label: Transformer vertical supply chain $500-700M
triggers.quote: investing approximately $500,000,000 to $700,000,000 over the next several years in our power transformer manufacturing facilities

triggers.label: Shift from one-to-two-year bids to 5-10 year programmatic
triggers.quote: we were bidding on a one-year type, two-year type things. Now we are not bidding at all. We are negotiating five-, ten-year type programmatic spends.

triggers.label: 2026 FCF $1.8B midpoint
triggers.quote: we expect free cash flow of $1,800,000,000 at the midpoint of our range

guidance.quote: we expect free cash flow of $1,800,000,000 at the midpoint of our range
the opportunity to deliver over 20% growth in adjusted EPS

guidance.metric: Revenue, net income, adj EBITDA growth 2026
guidance.quote: continued double-digit growth in revenues, net income, and adjusted EBITDA
margins in Electric Infrastructure, 10.3% at the midpoint

red_flags.label: Margin flat despite growth; 6,000 organic hires pressure margins
red_flags.quote: We do, organically we will grow around 6,000 employees. That is pressure on those margins

red_flags.label: Management declines margin expansion push
red_flags.quote: I do not think you are going to see any of these outward margins

evasions.quote: It is not a margin story. I will say it again.

evasions.topic: Data-centre share of work turned down / pipeline
evasions.quote: I think some of it is hype, but even if you discount it 50%
